senses.gloss:
The सिच् आत्मनेपद affixes are कित् after the root हन् 'to kill'.

Terms: कित्

बध् is the substitute of हन् 'to kill' when the आर्धधातुक लिङ् (Benedictive) follows.

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

After the root हनु 'to kill' when in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition comes the affix क्यप् in denoting condition and the letter त is the substitute of its final.

Terms: Irregular

The affix अप् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when without an उपसर्ग , in the sense of mere action and वध is the substitute of हन् 'to kill' before this affix.

Terms: अप्

ज is substituted for हन् before the Imperative affix हि।

Terms: अभीय Rules

त् is substituted for the न् of the root हन् 'to kill' before an affix with a indicatory ञ् or ण् which also causes वृद्धि of the penultimate अ , but the augment is not added before the Aorist sign nor before the Personal ending णल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

Terms: वृद्धि

An Imperative with a preposition preceding it, may optionally retain its accent, in connection with हन्त , but not in the 1st person.

Terms: Accent

The न , when preceded by अ , in the root हन् , is changed to ण , when the verb is preceded by a preposition competent to cause the change.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-धातु
